The pinned libVLC-Android 3.7.7 AAR supplies the optional native C API.
InfiniSound dynamically resolves it; no extra native engine binary is bundled.
NSF and similar looping formats use the selected track metadata play length,
or a 150 second loop window when none is supplied, followed by an 8 second fade.
This is a rendering policy, not an assertion of an intrinsic file duration.
